The first thing a professional notices after a Brazilian clean is not the shine on the counters. It is the baseboards. Most services stop at the visible surfaces, and the edge of the floor is where a rushed clean shows. If you work long hours in Greer and have been let down by quick cleans, this is the article about what is different with Brazilian house cleaning in Greer.

What the first visit actually looks like

Expect the first visit to take longer than the rest. The team is not only cleaning, it is resetting the home to a standard that recurring visits then maintain. A typical first visit goes in this order:

  1. A short walkthrough with you or by phone to confirm priorities
  2. Top surfaces and door frames first, so dust falls to the floor
  3. Kitchen next: stovetop, hood and cabinet fronts degreased
  4. Bathrooms, with grout and the toilet base scrubbed
  5. Furniture and small items moved, cleaned under and put back
  6. Floors last, washed by hand along the walls
  7. A final walk-through against the room checklist

Because the checklist is the same each time, you do not have to remember to ask for the same things again. That is the feature people with full calendars value the most.

Recurring visits cost less per visit, which is the reason most professionals who book once end up setting a regular day.

What the service includes

The Brazilian house cleaning service covers:

  • Every surface hand-wiped, not just sprayed
  • Corners, edges and baseboards by hand
  • Furniture and small items moved and cleaned under
  • Door frames, switches and handles detailed
  • Bathrooms scrubbed, grout and toilet base included
  • Kitchen degreased: stovetop, hood and cabinet fronts
  • Floors hand-washed along the walls
  • A final walk-through against the checklist

Perfect Services does not quote from a message. The price comes after a free in-home estimate, where someone sees the rooms and talks through the schedule. No commitment. For a working client the visit is short, and you can book it around your day. Price depends on:

Access, privacy and the routine

Most of our professional clients are not home during the clean. At the estimate we agree how the team gets in, which rooms are off limits and how to handle pets. We recommend putting away anything you would not want moved: open mail, a laptop, a charging cable. The team cleans around work in progress, and anything on a desk stays where it was.

Greer neighborhoods near GSP Airport and the BMW plant have newer homes with large kitchens and open living areas, and these fit a recurring schedule well, because a hardwood or tile floor that stays up to date is easier to keep up than one that has been left for months. Many of our clients live along I-85, SC-14 and SC-101 and commute out of town, and the home base in Greer means a crew about ten minutes away.

What you will notice after a few visits

The changes are small and cumulative. The edge of the hardwood stops turning gray. The bathroom grout holds its color. The tops of door frames and the back of the stove stop collecting what you cannot see. A rushed clean is easy to spot after a week, because the surfaces are wiped but the corners are the same as before. A hand-cleaned home does not have that problem, since the corners are done on every visit and not saved for a deep clean.

If you share the home with a partner or roommates, agree on one person who approves the checklist, so the team gets one set of instructions instead of three. Changes after that are a text message away, and the checklist stays the reference for every visit. People often start with the kitchen and bathrooms as priorities and add bedrooms and the living room once they see the result, which is a perfectly normal way to build up the schedule.

What to tell the team before the first visit

  • Which rooms matter most to you, such as the kitchen or the main bathroom
  • Any surfaces that need gentle handling, like stone countertops or unsealed wood
  • Pets, and where they should stay while the team is there
  • Anything the team should not touch, like a home office desk
  • Your preferred day and time window

How long it takes and starting this week

Plan for a half day on the first visit in a typical home, and less after that. If you want to start this week, tell us on the form and we will check the schedule.
